item.title: 2026 Special MacCracken Award
item.description: I am honored to be a recipient of the 2026 Special MacCracken Award at NYU Langone. The award recognizes students for qualities including scholastic achievement, an inclusive spirit, professionalism, leadership, and contributions to recruitment.

item.title: NESS 2026 Best Student Paper Award
item.description: I have been awarded the Best Student Paper Award at the 2026 NESS Symposium for my paper on 'General Targeted Machine Learning in Modern Causal Mediation Analysis'.

item.title: Presentation at ACIC 2026
item.description: Organized the session “An Overview of Automatic Non-parametric (Riesz) Learning for Causal Effects Estimation” in Salt Lake City, Utah, USA. Presented “General targeted machine learning for modern causal mediation analysis” in Salt Lake City, Utah, USA.

item.title: Deming Conference 2026 Best Student Poster Award
item.description: I have been awarded the Best Student Poster Award at the 2026 Deming Conference on Applied Statistics, for my poster on 'General Targeted Machine Learning in Modern Causal Mediation Analysis'.
